column1: # Adventure Guide texts, read by build_adventure_guide.py. One line each, TAB separated:
#   map <TAB> map id <TAB> overview of the instance (map id + 100000: the Temucraft heroic of a stock dungeon)
#   zone <TAB> map id <TAB> where the entrance is (wins over the zone the script works out)
#   npc <TAB> creature entry <TAB> description of a boss (without one the window writes level and title)
#   name <TAB> map id <TAB> name to show;  level <TAB> map id <TAB> min-max (first difficulty)

column3: Ragefire Chasm is a network of volcanic caves beneath Orgrimmar, where the Searing Blade cult and its troggs plot against the Horde from the city's own foundations.
Orgrimmar
Once the greatest gold mine of Westfall, the Deadmines now hide Edwin VanCleef's Defias Brotherhood and the juggernaut they are building to take their revenge on Stormwind.
Westfall
The Wailing Caverns lie beneath an oasis of the Barrens. The druid Naralex tried to heal the land from here; his Nightmare twisted the caves and the Druids of the Fang who followed him.
The Barrens
Archmage Arugal's keep in Silverpine Forest. His summoned worgen curse turned Baron Silverlaine's halls into a den of beasts, and Arugal still rules them from the tower.
Silverpine Forest
Blackfathom Deeps was a temple of Elune on the shore of Ashenvale until it sank. The Twilight's Hammer now gathers there around the old god servant Aku'mai.
Ashenvale
The Stockade is Stormwind's prison. A riot led by the Defias and Bazil Thredd has put the inmates in charge of the cells.
Stormwind City
Razorfen Kraul is a maze of giant thorny vines, home of the quilboar, where Charlix and Agathelos serve the demigod Agamaggan's fallen children.
The Barrens
Once the wonder of gnomish technology, Gnomeregan fell when troggs burst up from below and Mekgineer Thermaplugg flooded it with radiation. The gnomes want their city back.
Dun Morogh
The Scarlet Crusade's fortress in Tirisfal Glades: the Graveyard, the Library, the Armory and the Cathedral, where High Inquisitor Whitemane and Scarlet Commander Mograine lead the zealots.
Tirisfal Glades
The heart of the quilboar's thorny vines in the Barrens, where the Scourge's Lich Amnennar the Coldbringer has raised an undead army among the Razorfen.
The Barrens
Uldaman is a titan vault buried in the Badlands. The Dwarves of the Explorers' League and the Dark Iron dig for its secrets while the titans' guardians stir.
Badlands
Sacred to the centaur of Desolace, Maraudon is where Zaetar and Theradras are buried. Their children and the corrupted earth below guard the Scepter of Celebras.
Desolace
The sandfury trolls' sunbaked city in Tanaris. Chief Ukorz Sandscalp and the witch doctors gather sacrifices for the hydra Gahz'rilla.
Tanaris
The Temple of Atal'Hakkar sank into the Swamp of Sorrows when the Atal'ai tried to summon the blood god Hakkar. His priests and the green dragons sent to stop them are still there.
Swamp of Sorrows
The Dark Iron dwarves' capital deep in Blackrock Mountain. Emperor Dagran Thaurissan rules it from the Imperial Seat, in the service of Ragnaros.
Blackrock Mountain
The ruined night elf city of Eldre'Thalas in Feralas: the ogres of Gordok hold the North, the satyrs and demons the East, and the Shen'dralar's ancient magic the West.
Feralas
The upper reaches of Blackrock Mountain, where the Blackrock orcs of Warchief Rend Blackhand and the black dragonflight of General Drakkisath prepare their armies.
Blackrock Mountain
The Barov family's crypt on Caer Darrow became the school of necromancy of the Cult of the Damned, run by Darkmaster Gandling.
Western Plaguelands
The Scourge's hold of Stratholme, the city Arthas purged: Baron Rivendare rules the undead side, and the Scarlet Crusade fights on in the living side.
Eastern Plaguelands
Beneath the Scarab Wall of Silithus, the old god C'Thun stirs in the temple city of the qiraji, ready to lead his insects out against Azeroth.
Silithus
Nefarian's lair at the peak of Blackrock Mountain, where he breeds the chromatic dragonflight for his war on his father's foes.
Blackrock Mountain
Molten Core lies at the bottom of Blackrock Mountain: Ragnaros, the Firelord, waits here with his lieutenants, the core hounds and the molten giants.
Blackrock Mountain
The outer city of Ahn'Qiraj, where General Rajaxx and Ossirian the Unscarred hold the gates of the qiraji empire.
Silithus
The capital of the Gurubashi trolls in Stranglethorn, where the Atal'ai priests have summoned Hakkar the Soulflayer, the blood god.
Stranglethorn Vale
The black dragon Onyxia, daughter of Deathwing, guards her lair in the Dustwallow Marsh with her brood of whelps.
Dustwallow Marsh
The Hellfire Ramparts are the outer walls of Hellfire Citadel, held by the fel orcs of the Fel Horde and their dragon Nazan.
Hellfire Peninsula
In the Blood Furnace the Fel Horde turns orcs into fel orcs with the blood of the pit lord Magtheridon.
Hellfire Peninsula
The Shattered Halls, the heart of Hellfire Citadel, where Warchief Kargath Bladefist commands the Fel Horde.
Hellfire Peninsula
Magtheridon, the pit lord who ruled Outland for Illidan, lies chained beneath Hellfire Citadel while the Fel Horde drains his blood.
Hellfire Peninsula
The naga of Lady Vashj pump the waters of Zangarmarsh into Coilfang Reservoir. The Slave Pens hold the broken and the Lost Ones who do the work.
Zangarmarsh
The Underbog: the marsh's fungal giants and hydras live in the caves of Coilfang Reservoir, among the naga's experiments.
Zangarmarsh
In the Steamvault the naga drain Zangarmarsh's water for Lady Vashj, guarded by Warlord Kalithresh.
Zangarmarsh
Serpentshrine Cavern, the deepest chamber of Coilfang Reservoir, where Lady Vashj gives her orders.
Zangarmarsh
The Mana-Tombs of Auchindoun, robbed of their power by the ethereal Prince-Nexus Shaffar and his Consortium.
Terokkar Forest
The Auchenai Crypts, the draenei's burial grounds in Auchindoun, now held by the Auchenai death cult.
Terokkar Forest
The Sethekk Halls of Auchindoun, where the arakkoa of the Sethekk worship their god Anzu.
Terokkar Forest
The Shadow Labyrinth, Auchindoun's heart, where the Shadow Council summons demons under Murmur's gaze.
Terokkar Forest
The Caverns of Time take you to Durnholde Keep in the past, to help young Thrall escape his captors before the Infinite Dragonflight can change history.
Tanaris
At the Black Morass, the Infinite Dragonflight tries to keep Medivh from opening the Dark Portal. The timeline must stay as it was.
Tanaris
At Mount Hyjal, in the past, Archimonde marches on the World Tree. Hold the line with Jaina, Thrall and Tyrande.
Tanaris
The Magisters' Terrace on the Isle of Quel'Danas, where Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider returns in the service of Kil'jaeden.
Isle of Quel'Danas
The Arcatraz: Tempest Keep's prison, where the Sha'tar's enemies are held and Harbinger Skyriss gathers power.
Netherstorm
The Botanica, Tempest Keep's garden, where the blood elves twist the plants of Outland.
Netherstorm
The Mechanar, Tempest Keep's engine room, whose machines and Pathaleon the Calculator guard the way to the Eye.
Netherstorm
The Eye of Tempest Keep, the naaru fortress taken by Prince Kael'thas, where he waits with his advisors and the phoenix Al'ar.
Netherstorm
The Black Temple, once the draenei temple of Karabor, is Illidan Stormrage's seat in Shadowmoon Valley. His lieutenants guard the way to the Betrayer.
Shadowmoon Valley
Gruul the Dragonkiller rules the gronn of Blade's Edge Mountains from his lair, with his sons and High King Maulgar.
Blade's Edge Mountains
Medivh's tower in Deadwind Pass. The Last Guardian is gone, but his ghosts, his servants and the demon Prince Malchezaar haunt it still.
Deadwind Pass
The Sunwell Plateau: Kil'jaeden is trying to step through the Sunwell into Azeroth. Stop the Burning Legion's lord before he arrives.
Isle of Quel'Danas
The Amani trolls' city in Ghostlands, where Zul'jin gathers the animal gods' avatars for his revenge on the elves.
Ghostlands
Utgarde Keep in Howling Fjord, where the vrykul of the Dragonflayer clan raise their dead for the Lich King.
Howling Fjord
Utgarde Pinnacle, the top of the vrykul fortress, where King Ymiron has turned his people to the Lich King.
Howling Fjord
The Nexus, home of the blue dragonflight in Coldarra, where Malygos's dragons gather the world's magic.
Borean Tundra
The Oculus, a floating ring above the Nexus. Ride the dragons of the red, green and bronze flights against Malygos's servants.
Borean Tundra
The Eye of Eternity: Malygos the Spell-Weaver, Aspect of Magic, wages his Nexus War from here.
Borean Tundra
Azjol-Nerub, the nerubian kingdom beneath Dragonblight, where Anub'arak serves the Lich King.
Dragonblight
Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom, beneath Azjol-Nerub, where the Faceless Ones serve Yogg-Saron.
Dragonblight
Drak'Tharon Keep, a Drakkari fortress taken by the Scourge on the border of Grizzly Hills and Zul'Drak.
Zul'Drak
The Violet Hold, Dalaran's prison. The blue dragonflight is breaking in to free its prisoners.
Dalaran
Gundrak, the capital of the Drakkari trolls, where they sacrifice their own gods for power against the Scourge.
Zul'Drak
The Halls of Stone in Ulduar. Help Brann Bronzebeard read the Tribunal of Ages' history of the earthen.
The Storm Peaks
The Halls of Lightning, where Loken, a titan keeper turned to Yogg-Saron, rules the iron dwarves.
The Storm Peaks
Ulduar, the titans' city in the Storm Peaks, where the old god Yogg-Saron lies imprisoned and has corrupted the keepers.
The Storm Peaks
The Culling of Stratholme: the Caverns of Time take you back to the day Arthas Menethil purged the plagued city.
Tanaris
The Trial of the Champion: the Argent Crusade's Coliseum tests the champions of the Alliance and the Horde.
Icecrown
The Trial of the Crusader: the Argent Crusade's tournament pits the strongest against the Lich King's beasts and champions.
Icecrown
The Forge of Souls, the first of the Frozen Halls of Icecrown Citadel, where souls are bound to the Lich King's will.
Icecrown
Pit of Saron, where Forgemaster Garfrost's slaves mine the saronite for the Lich King's armies.
Icecrown
The Halls of Reflection, where Frostmourne's power is kept. The Lich King himself waits behind them.
Icecrown
Icecrown Citadel, the Lich King's fortress. Face his lieutenants and the Lich King on the Frozen Throne.
Icecrown
Naxxramas, Kel'Thuzad's floating necropolis, has returned over Dragonblight to carry the Scourge's war across Northrend.
Dragonblight
The Obsidian Sanctum beneath Wyrmrest Temple, where Sartharion and the black dragonflight guard the twilight eggs.
Dragonblight
The Ruby Sanctum beneath Wyrmrest Temple, where Halion and the Twilight dragonflight attack the red dragons.
Dragonblight
The Vault of Archavon in Wintergrasp Fortress. Whoever holds the fortress may face the stone watchers inside.
Wintergrasp
Temucraft's heroic Deadmines: the Cataclysm version of the dungeon for level 80. Vanessa VanCleef has rebuilt the Brotherhood and wants her father's revenge.
Westfall
Temucraft's heroic Shadowfang Keep: the Cataclysm version for level 80. Lord Godfrey and his men, raised as Forsaken, have taken the keep.
Silverpine Forest
The Vortex Pinnacle, a city of air spirits above Uldum, where Al'Akir's servants guard the way to the Skywall.
Uldum
The Halls of Origination, the titans' vault in Uldum. Its keepers judge whoever tries to use the titans' machines to rewrite the world.
Uldum
The Lost City of the Tol'vir, where the Neferset tol'vir, who sided with Deathwing, hold the lost city.
Uldum
The Throne of the Four Winds, Al'Akir's home in the Skywall, high above Uldum.
Uldum
The Firelands, Ragnaros's home in the Elemental Plane, where the Firelord prepares his return to Mount Hyjal.
Mount Hyjal
The Temple of the Jade Serpent in the Jade Forest, where the sha of doubt rises in the temple of Yu'lon.
The Jade Forest
Mogu'shan Vaults in Kun-Lai Summit, where the mogu's ancient emperors and their guardians wake.
Kun-Lai Summit
The Siege of Orgrimmar: Garrosh Hellscream has used the heart of Y'Shaarj. Take the city back from him.
Vale of Eternal Blossoms

column1: # Boss descriptions (hand-checked sample: Ragefire Chasm, the Deadmines, Molten Core, Karazhan, Naxxramas)

column3: The troggs of Ragefire Chasm follow Oggleflint, the largest of them, who lurks at the entrance.
A warlock of the Searing Blade, Jergosh calls on curses and fire to defend the cult's caverns.
Bazzalan leads the Searing Blade and plots against Thrall from beneath Orgrimmar.
The demon Taragaman feeds on the Searing Blade's sacrifices. He strikes with hellfire and his fiery fists.
The foreman of the Defias miners. He keeps them digging with his fists.
The Defias's lumbermaster drives his shredder at anyone who comes near his mill.
Gilnid, the Defias smelter, melts the gold mine's ores down for VanCleef's war chest.
The first mate of the Defias's ship. Mr. Smite switches weapons as the fight goes on and stuns those close to him.
The ship's cook. Cookie throws his food at you and heals himself with it.
Captain Greenskin commands the Defias's ship and its crew of pirates.
The Defias Kingpin and master stonemason. Edwin VanCleef blames Stormwind for his unpaid wages and calls his guards when the fight turns against him.
Lucifron brings curses and doom to his foes, with his two Flamewaker Protectors at his side.
The great core hound Magmadar breathes lava and sends his foes fleeing in panic.
Gehennas curses his foes so that they can hardly be healed, and rains fire down on them.
Garr, the firelord, is surrounded by Firesworn that burst when they die.
Shazzrah, a flamewaker sorcerer, blinks among his foes and curses their magic.
Baron Geddon turns his foes into living bombs and blows the fire of the core across the room.
Ragnaros's herald, Sulfuron Harbinger, fights with four Flamewaker Priests who heal him.
Golemagg the Incinerator commands two core ragers that cannot die while he lives.
Majordomo Executus, the steward of the Firelord, defends his master's chambers with his elite guards.
Ragnaros the Firelord, the elemental lord of fire. Banished into the Molten Core, he waits to burn the world. He submerges and sends his Sons of Flame when wounded.
Attumen the Huntsman rides his horse Midnight through Karazhan's stables, a ghost of the tower's hunts.
Moroes, the tower's steward, still holds the dinner party for his master's guests, all of whom have died.
The Maiden of Virtue, a titan construct, punishes the wicked who enter her chamber.
Barnes, the stage manager, presents the opera: the Wizard of Oz, Romulo and Julianne or the Big Bad Wolf.
The Curator, an arcane construct, defends the tower's library and summons Astral Flares.
The warlock Terestian Illhoof binds his imps and his demon chains in the tower's attic.
The Shade of Aran, Medivh's father, still guards his library with fire, frost and arcane magic.
Netherspite, a nether dragon, feeds on the tower's beams of power. Turn them on him to weaken him.
The chess board of Karazhan: you play Medivh's own game with the pieces as your army.
Prince Malchezaar, a demon prince of the Burning Legion, has taken Karazhan's top tower. His infernals rain down from the sky.
Nightbane, the black dragon Medivh once slew, comes back to life when the urn on the terrace is used.
Anub'Rekhan, the nerubian lord who served Arthas, swarms his foes with locusts in the Arachnid Quarter.
Grand Widow Faerlina leads the Cult of the Damned's worshippers who serve Kel'Thuzad.
Maexxna, the great spider of Naxxramas, wraps her foes in webs and poisons them.
Noth the Plaguebringer, the alchemist who brewed the plague, teleports and raises his skeletal servants.
Heigan the Unclean makes the floor erupt with plague: dance between the safe parts of his room.
Loatheb, a giant spore creature, stops all but the strongest healing magic.
Instructor Razuvious trains the death knights of Naxxramas. Use his understudies against him.
Gothik the Harvester summons living and dead troops on both sides of his room.
Patchwerk, Kel'Thuzad's champion abomination, strikes the toughest foes near him with Hateful Strikes.
Grobbulus, an abomination of slime, sprays mutating injections on his foes.
Gluth, a giant plague hound, feasts on zombies to heal himself and decimates everyone around him.
Thaddius, an abomination made from tortured souls, charges his foes with positive and negative polarity.
Sapphiron, the frost wyrm, freezes his foes in ice blocks and breathes frost on them.
Kel'Thuzad, the lich who rules Naxxramas for the Lich King, summons his minions from the walls before he fights.
